description: Buddy’s deception becomes harder to contain as church politics, criminal consequences and personal relationships close in from several directions at once.

s02e01.description: Buddy’s attempt to outmaneuver the detectives investigating him backfires, while Dora, Alexa and Russell begin suspecting something much darker about their pastor and Schmidt learns the truth about Ashlee.

s02e02.description: The church courts an eccentric elderly woman in hopes she will leave them her estate, while Dora dates Detective Lovello and Schmidt makes an unsettling confession.

s02e03.description: An ex-con threatens to burn down Trinity Lutheran, Dora’s relationship with Lovello becomes dangerous and Russell helps Schmidt establish his new life as a bachelor.

s02e04.description: Buddy becomes trapped by a dangerous criminal while the church council tries to stop an arson attack on Trinity and Dora reconnects with an old high-school crush.

s02e05.description: With Dora and Alexa both threatened, Buddy is forced to decide whom he can protect, while Russell and Dora fall out and Schmidt becomes the victim of a robbery.

s02e06.description: Bishop Perkins returns with news that could upend Trinity, Sheriff Graham intensifies his murder investigation around Buddy and Alexa reveals a secret that changes the stakes.

s02e07.description: Russell pressures Buddy to take a more visible role in the gay community, Sheriff Graham recruits Dora to spy on Buddy and Alexa, and Schmidt publicly embraces his relationship with Ashlee.

s02e08.description: Buddy’s attempt to counsel Russell’s younger brother goes badly, Dora challenges Schmidt for church president and Buddy struggles to keep his feelings for Alexa from complicating everything else.

s02e09.description: The FBI unveils a plan involving Buddy just as Sheriff Graham moves decisively against him, while Dora becomes convinced that the pastor is hiding a secret relationship.

s02e10.description: Alexa’s husband arrives unexpectedly, Dora uncovers something frightening and Schmidt’s engagement party takes a sharp turn, leaving Buddy’s carefully improvised life close to collapse.
